workload: unchanged 64x64 copy, 16 lanes x 8 warps per CU, 512-bit AXI, read delay 2, write ACK delay 12
interpretation: Read merging improves cycles modestly. Four dynamically shared staging credits eliminate most staging arbitration stalls but alone regress four-CU elapsed cycles by 0.7%; they do not solve framebuffer throughput. Copy target >=3x remains unmet. No desktop wall-time claim.
semantics: Only pending lower read snapshots are merged; completed lines are not cached.
Same-word writes close older read windows even after the write ACK retires.
Per-word credits remain reserved through upstream reply consumption.
Staging IDs [0,4) remain separate from DMA [4,8); owner/local IDs are restored on out-of-order replies.
